_comment: MIRROR of src/data/enemies.js maxHp, indexed by ENEMIES position. CARDINAL RULE: this file and src/data/enemies.js MUST be updated in the SAME commit — the sim reads this file, the live game reads enemies.js via getScaledMaxHp, and any drift means the sim measures a game that does not exist. Enforced by vestibule-sim-kwstacks.js on load and by e2e/test-card-parity.cjs.
_lucifer_exception: Entry 26 (Lucifer) is DELIBERATELY 666666 and NOT the 100000 in enemies.js. Lucifer is special-cased in App.jsx getScaledMaxHp (~line 5209): it returns a FLAT 333,333 per phase / 666,666 total, with NO deck hpScale and no boss-kill reduction, keyed on passiveId===luciferBoss. The maxHp:100000 field in enemies.js is DEAD DATA for Lucifer — nothing reads it for the actual fight. vestibule-sim-kwstacks.js:1488 hardcodes the same 666666 and splits it into two phases, which is CORRECT and matches live. Aug 4 2026: this entry was briefly "synced" to 100000 on the mistaken belief that the 666666 was a cardinal-rule violation. It is not — it is the real fight value. The sync assertion must EXEMPT entry 26.
